verse: Rejoice greatly, O Daughter of Zion! Shout in triumph, O Daughter of Jerusalem! See, your King comes to you, righteous and victorious, humble and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
story: Every king in the ancient world arrived on a warhorse, so a king on a donkey would have stopped a crowd in its tracks.

Zechariah calls Jerusalem to rejoice because her King is coming. He is righteous and carries salvation with Him, yet He is humble, riding the foal of a donkey rather than a charger. The study sets this beside the LORD marching in judgment against proud nations: this King wins by saving, and He proclaims peace and reigns from sea to sea. The Gospels see Jesus ride into Jerusalem in exactly this way.
Our King came gently. Take that gentleness as an invitation to rest, and to treat others the same way.
theme: Advent: waiting, promise, the coming King
